practice_observation: The independent look found a dead drawn offset that made every turn-on the same 12 Hz strobe, which all 69 plus 958 tests and the worker's own look missed; a second reviewer on a different package found the first repair still failed one burst in five. Viewing lit and off crops before review found the window and smear early. Carrying another session's commit made the scope check fail by construction; landing it as its own PR and rebasing was the clean repair, so a defect found in another outcome's assets should go to its owner first. Costs: study review gates took 5 to 7 min each under load, two usage-limit stops, and about 17 h from final commit to merge in the queue and reboot. The card routed Luna and a Sonnet session delivered, so this does not test Luna.
